Removed Businesses

The Removed Businesses screen displays a list of all businesses that have been removed but not permanently deleted.

Removed businesses are not accessible for normal operations but can be restored if needed. They continue to occupy storage space until permanently deleted.

From this screen, you can either restore a removed business to make it active again, or permanently delete it to free up storage space.

To restore a business, click on its name in the list. To permanently delete a business and free up storage space, click the X button next to the business name.
